stories.headline: Russia threatens ‘hostile’ Estonia with ‘open war’
stories.description: Moscow accuses Tallinn of ‘hostile actions’ citing border closure and claiming it is allowing Ukraine to launch attacks.

stories.headline: India pledges $1.6bn in flood relief for Nepal as Balendra Shah visits Modi
stories.description: Nepal’s Prime Minister Balendra Shah is in New Delhi for a two-day visit — his first since coming to power in March.

stories.headline: Danish top court’s ‘ghetto law’ ruling supports hardline immigration policy
stories.description: The country’s top court said eviction of ‘non-Western’ families did not constitute discrimination.

stories.headline: Tajikistan moves to leave ICC amid US push against court
stories.description: The ICC found that Tajikistan failed to comply with its request to arrest Russian President Vladimir Putin.
